ment century, heralding the start

court history, scoring at a fast
clip, almost getting on with the
business of galloping to the
greatness goal at a strike rate of
72-plus. He became the 33rd

male cricketer to score a hun-
dred on Test captaincy debut.
Jaiswal opens the innings like
Rohit, and Shubman has taken

match day after the two big re-
tirements, no one was missed by
anyone as India finished at 359
for three. After the day's play,
coach Gautam Gambhir was
smiling — he, too, grins only
when the situation demands.
Considering that Indian
openers in England rarely do
well, and laying the foundation
is of utmost importance,
Jaiswal's innings was uniqueand
significant. Itwas an innings that
had Kohli’s aggression and

Sharma's grace.

ble journey, from living in atent

ant void left behind by the bat-

stature,

about Jaiswal but never seen him
live. When England toured India

ble hundreds. It was the series

partner, Rohit, too wasn't around

England bowling department.
